about: How Vesqira recognises a run of a tool and which of its outputs fill which generic role (ADR 0068, item 1). A profile only declares: a file and a key inside it that identify a run, and the names the tool gives its outputs. Reading the file, validating values and registering outputs stay in Vesqira's own code, and a profile never runs anything. What it supplies is labelled profile:<name>@<version>, never verified. Generic roles are the ids in 'roles'; an output a tool names that fits none of them is a declared extra, shown by the tool's own name. The orientation conventions (header cards) of the same tool are in the worker's orientation_profiles.json, linked by the 'orientation' name (one file for both is the consolidation step recorded in ADR 0068).

template.title: VGT run
template.about: Runs VGT.jl on a copy of a config from the host, with the settings you change applied and every other line as it was. The output folder is set for each job, inside the host's source folders, so the results can be opened here.

repo.hint: The checkout of VGT.jl (main.jl is its entry point). The profile was written against commit af0a794; a job stops on another revision only if you ask for that below.
repo.refusal: the VGT folder must be an absolute path without spaces or quotes
repo.verified: At af0a794 (main): main.jl, config.example.toml and the keys listed here exist, and noise_mode takes scalar, channel, spatial, separable or auto (src/config.jl). The script was not run on a cluster for this record.

keys.name: input_file
keys.label: Input cube on the host
keys.description: The FITS cube the run reads.

keys.name: ker
keys.label: ker (smoothing, pixels)
keys.description: Gaussian smoothing sigma applied to the Q and U maps before the angle is computed, in pixels.

default.reason: the value in VGT.jl's config.example.toml at af0a794

keys.name: dn
keys.label: dn (window, pixels)
keys.description: Window size in pixels (even). A larger window averages more gradients (smoother, less detail) and costs more memory and time per chunk.

default.reason: the value in VGT.jl's config.example.toml at af0a794

keys.name: min_valid
keys.label: min_valid
keys.description: Minimum number of valid above-threshold gradients a window needs before it is fitted.

default.reason: the value in VGT.jl's config.example.toml at af0a794

keys.name: noise
keys.label: noise (1 sigma)
keys.description: The 1-sigma noise floor in data units.

keys.name: noise_mode
keys.label: noise mode
keys.description: How the noise threshold is modelled: one value, per channel, per spatial tile, or combinations of them.

default.reason: marked as the default in VGT.jl's config.example.toml at af0a794

keys.name: noise_sigma_multiplier
keys.label: noise sigma multiplier
keys.description: Multiplier on the noise floor that gives the mask threshold (3 with a 1-sigma noise is a 3-sigma threshold).

default.reason: the value in VGT.jl's config.example.toml at af0a794

keys.name: noise_tile_size
keys.label: noise tile size (pixels)
keys.description: Tile size of the spatial noise estimate, used by the spatial, separable and auto modes.

keys.name: angle_frame
keys.label: angle frame (PSIFRAME of the outputs)
keys.description: Frame of the written psi map: pixel (counter-clockwise from the image x axis), or galactic or icrs (IAU position angle through the cube's WCS).

default.reason: the value in VGT.jl's config.example.toml at af0a794

keys.name: output_bin
keys.label: output binning (pixels, 1 or more)
keys.description: Output grid: 1 keeps the input grid, b above 1 averages the smoothed Q, U and I over b by b input pixels and recomputes psi from them.

default.reason: the value in VGT.jl's config.example.toml at af0a794

keys.name: output_dir
keys.label: Output folder
keys.description: Set by Vesqira for each job, inside the host's source folders.

template.title: ROHSA decomposition
template.about: Runs the ROHSA build-and-decompose script of ROHSA-LMC on a copy of a ROHSA config from the host, with the settings you change applied (every other line as it was). The output folder is set for each job, inside the host's source folders; when the job completes its fit is imported from there (the .dat stays on the host and is indexed there when you first open its components).

repo.hint: The checkout of ROHSA-LMC, which holds rohsa/cli/preprocess.jl. The profile was written against commit baf4a3b; a job stops on another revision only if you ask for that below.
repo.refusal: the folder and the config must be absolute paths without spaces or quotes
repo.verified: At baf4a3b (main): rohsa/cli/preprocess.jl, configs/rohsa/full_cube.toml, rohsa/configs.jl (which names the keys listed here) and rohsa/upstream/ROHSA/src/Makefile exist. The script was not run on a cluster for this record.

guard.refusal: this config runs the pipeline's own candidate sweep ([auto_config] enabled), whose axes Vesqira does not edit; use a config without it
